title: Guara Space Mission Intent v0
description: The only artifact a language model is allowed to produce in the space thread (ADR 0010 rule 6, ADR 0012, risk RS-6). Closed vocabulary: no F´ command name, no Fpy directive, no actuator, no quaternion. The compiler, not the model, turns an intent into a validated sequence.

boresight_id.description: Protected aperture from the vehicle model; the model may not invent one.

target_id.description: Named pointing target from the vehicle model (nadir, ground-station, ...).

hold_s.description: Requested hold duration for point_hold. null lets the compiler use the site default. A request, not a command.
